details: The United Kingdom has imposed a new package of sanctions targeting Russian cryptoasset exchanges, including HTX, Aifory Pro, and Arvix LLC, along with the "A7 network." These entities are accused of assisting the Russian government in evading existing restrictions and funding its war efforts. This marks the first time the UK has applied Regulation 17A to crypto exchanges, significantly expanding compliance obligations for virtual asset service providers.
title: UK Sanctions Target Russian Crypto Exchanges and Network A7

details: Global financial markets are increasingly focusing on inflation and potential interest rate hikes as negotiations between the U.S. and Iran continue, despite lingering significant disagreements. Expectations for rate hikes are resurfacing, with U.S. interest rate futures pricing in a potential Federal Reserve hike as early as October. While an easing of geopolitical tensions could offer short-term support for Bitcoin, a continuation of rising interest rates would likely pressure highly leveraged and overvalued crypto assets, dampening overall risk appetite.
title: Global Markets Eye Inflation and Rates Amid US-Iran Tensions, Crypto Impacted
